title: anoectochilus subregularis
intro: Anoectochilus subregularis, commonly known as the Dragon's Mouth, is a type of orchid species native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Anoectochilus subregularis include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve circulation, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
